<thought>To locate the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using only the target molecule SMILES, without additional bond criteria. This should return templates that match the molecule, including the Diels‑Alder (retro‑[4+2]) template. Once a suitable template is found, I will retrieve its mapped reaction SMILES and template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
